result.description:
Seven Corp on behalf of Adelaide Steel Frame Windows

Overview: 

Adelaide Steel Frame Windows is South Australia’s largest manufacturer of architectural steel doors and windows. Operating successfully for over 24 years, our continued growth has led to a recent expansion into a larger facility in Regency Park. We take immense pride in our craftsmanship, solid work ethic, and supportive team culture.

We are seeking a dedicated, full-time Metal Machinist / CNC Specialist to join our production team. In this role, your primary responsibility will be setting up, programming, and operating precision tools and machinery to shape high-tolerance steel components for our bespoke architectural doors and windows.

This position is ideal for a precision-focused tradesperson with comprehensive experience in both complex manual milling and turning operations alongside advanced CNC programming. Working alongside our workshop floor team, you will enhance productivity, ensure strict quality control, troubleshoot manufacturing challenges, and assist in mentoring apprentice team members.

Main Tasks:

-	Interpret complex technical drawings, blueprints, and engineering specifications to determine job requirements, tooling needs, and sequence of machining operations.
-	 Set up, program, and operate a variety of machine tools including CNC processing machines, lathes, milling machines, and precision grinders to shape steel components.
-	Calculate engineering parameters, feed rates, and cutting speeds; check fabricated components for conformity and extreme precision using micrometers, calipers, and gauges.
-	Embrace daily tradesperson challenges to diagnose, troubleshoot, and enhance overall machining and manufacturing processes.
-	Work closely alongside the workshop floor team to achieve optimal assembly timeframes, minimise material wastage, and maintain high-quality project outcomes.


Required/Relevant Qualifications & Work Experience:

-	Minimum AQF Certificate III in Engineering - Mechanical Trade (Machining)
-	A minimum of one year of full-time proven professional experience setting up, programming, and operating both CNC and manual metalworking machinery, or
-	At least 3 years of relevant experience as a Metal Machinist to substitute the formal qualification.
-	Forklift license 
-	White card
-	Current driver’s license.

Required/Relevant Skills & Knowledge:

-	Demonstrated ability to write, edit, and optimise CNC programs (G-code/M-code or conversational) at the machine control panel.
-	High proficiency in traditional manual turning, milling, drilling, and surface grinding techniques.
-	Advanced skill in using precision measuring instruments (micrometers, height gauges, dial indicators, calipers) to hold tight tolerances.
-	Sound understanding of metal properties (specifically structural and architectural steel grades), insert selection, speeds, feeds, and coolant applications.
-	Strong spatial awareness and ability to convert complex 2D/3D engineering drawings into finished physical components.
-	Strong diagnostic skills for troubleshooting machining chatter, tool wear, and alignment issues.
-	Pride in producing clean, accurate, and repeatable craftsmanship suited for premium architectural applications.

If you are a motivated, Metal Machinist looking to become a critical part of our leading steel frame manufacturing business, please submit your resume and a brief cover letter outlining your machinery experience, CNC programming capabilities, and alignment with our team values via the application link.

Annual salary will be between $75,000.00 to $85,000.00 (plus superannuation) depending on level of experience.

Job Types: Full-time, Permanent

Supply Chain Analyst available in all states NSW, Qld, Vic, & WA.

At NEPEAN™ we are proud to be Australia’s leading privately owned engineering, mining services and industrial manufacturing organisation. We have unique capabilities to deliver high value, innovative and sustainable solutions for the world’s leading mining, construction, and transport companies. Over the last 40 years, hard work, technical credibility, and a willingness to tackle very difficult projects have earned NEPEAN an enviable reputation. Today our organisation employs over 1400 people across six continents and distributes products to more than 65 countries.

We service our customers through multiple businesses in our portfolio: NEPEAN Building and Infrastructure (Galserv, Galintel, Weldlok), NEPEAN Engineering and Innovation, NEPEAN Power, Mining (NEPEAN Longwall), PROK, NEPEAN Conveyors, NEPEAN Transport, Gurtec, Roxon, and NEPEAN Belting Mackay.

We are currently offering a fantastic opportunity for Supply Chain Analyst to be based at our WA Office. This role ensures the company’s supply meets the customers’ demand. Duties include overseeing the company’s supply chains, ensuring timely delivery and keeping the company on budget.

Key Responsibilities:
Initiate pre-project risk assessment/review and communicate findings to Key Stakeholders as applicable
Evaluate areas of supply chain operations that require improvement
Be involved in and where practical recommendations during tendering/estimating
Facilitate handover from Sales & conduct formal scope/contract review
Review existing design/build sequence aspects, communicate with Engineering & optimise, increase, or improve profitability throughout the lifetime of the project
Compile and facilitate a detailed P.E.P (project execution plan)
Produce and report all project scheduling and resource requirements ensuring adequate float and contingency for risk
Implement effective and accountable communication methods to relevant stakeholders (including but not limited to the client and key suppliers) to ensure clarity of understanding regarding the deliverables & expectations required
Produce cost tracking and variation communication methods in line with both internal & external reporting & cost capture requirements

Skills, Knowledge & Abilities:
Organisational and time management skills
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills
Strong attention to detail
Ability to work autonomously and as part of a team
Interpersonal and communication skills
Able to communicate with several departments to evaluate and improve operations

If you believe you have the right skills, experience and passion for succeeding in this role, please submit your cover letter and resume for consideration.

NEPEAN believes in diversity and is committed to providing Equal Employment opportunities for all applicants. We welcome applicants from all walks of life which also included various socio-economic, cultural, LGBTIQ, Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander backgrounds.

Salary: Between $79,499 and $82,000 per annum + Super

result.description:
Metal City Roofing offers expert construction services for commercial buildings, warehouses, offices, and retail spaces across Adelaide and South Australia. Whether you’re planning a new build or expanding your current premises, we specialise in delivering functional, modern, and code-compliant buildings—all up to two-storey high.

We understand the unique needs of business and industry—every project is tailored to suit operational requirements, site conditions, and budget. Backed by years of experience and a skilled construction team, we deliver safe, efficient, and high-quality builds with a focus on longevity and compliance.

We are seeking experienced and qualified MECHANICAL TECHNICIANS to join our team of professionals. We are looking for reliable individuals with a strong commitment to positively contribute to the success of our organisation.

Your duties will include but are not limited to:
Conduct regular inspections and maintenance of machinery and equipment to ensure optimal operation
Prepare drawings, plans and designs for mechanical engineering work under the direction of Mechanical Engineers
Conduct root cause analysis, fault-finding and diagnosing efficient solutions to machine breakdowns
Troubleshoot mechanical issues
Installs, removes, inspects and repairs mechanical spare parts like bearings, seals on typical mechanical equipment
Performs major overhaul of equipment with or without external contractors and vendors
Disassembles, assembles, observes, repairs, tests, collects data and prepares reports on equipment, as tasks related to maintenance
Maintaining non-electrical safety, process and utility equipment
Perform power plant rigging, and lifting equipment necessary for safely handling heavy machinery and materials
Optimise mechanical efficiency by adjusting machinery and equipment settings
Troubleshoot process equipment, automation issues that may arise at the manufacturing line
Ensuring that products meet compliance regulations
Carry out work instructions as given by Supervisor, work specifications, equipment operation
Supports improvement projects
Fabricates and repair metal products and parts by using machine shop tools and equipment
Controls downtime by performing routine preventative maintenance requirements, daily equipment inspections, and monitoring machine operational performance
Perform duties consistent with established safety rules and procedures
Installing and commissioning new equipment as directed
Communicating with and supporting engineers
Understand customer change request and provide schedule
Documenting machine safety and maintenance

To be considered for this role, you must have:
Trade Qualifications and +5 years proven relevant experience
Proficiency in diagnosing, repairing, and maintaining mechanical equipment
Strong knowledge of troubleshooting technique and problem-solving skills
Extensive knowledge of mechanical engineering designs, installations, maintenance, and repairs
Ability to interpret technical manuals, schematics, and diagrams
Excellent attention to detail and a proactive approach to maintenance tasks
Physically fit and able to work in various conditions
Ability to work well both independently and in a team environment
Strong communication skills
Self-motivated, organised, punctual and reliable
Must have great work ethics

If you have the skills and experiences we need and have a positive attitude, please apply now.
Salary: Between $79,499 and $82,000 per annum + Super

Smart Hill Constructions Pty Ltd 
(Reso Scaffold)
16 Prospect Place, Boronia VIC 3155

Full Time Architectural Draftsperson
$95,000 + superannuation

Summary
Smart Hill Construction Pty Ltd, trading as Reso Scaffold, is a growing construction company specialising in residential, commercial and industrial building projects. As the business continues to expand its design-and-construct capability, the company requires an experienced Architectural Draftsperson to prepare detailed architectural documentation, support project planning and coordinate technical drawings throughout the construction process.

Our Architectural Draftsperson will be responsible for preparing architectural drawings and construction documentation, interpreting design concepts, coordinating technical information and supporting the delivery of residential and commercial construction projects. The position provides specialised drafting support across the business and contributes to efficient project delivery, design coordination and regulatory compliance.

Duties and Responsibilities

Design Documentation and Drafting
•	Prepare architectural drawings, plans, elevations, sections and detailed construction documentation using CAD, Revit and BIM software
•	Translate architectural concepts, sketches and design specifications into accurate technical drawings for construction purposes
•	Revise and update drawings to reflect design changes, engineering requirements and client variations throughout project deliver

Project Documentation and Coordination
•	Prepare documentation required for planning approvals, building permits and construction documentation packages
•	Coordinate architectural drawings with structural, civil, mechanical and other consultant documentation to minimise design conflicts
•	Maintain project drawing registers, revision histories and document control throughout each stage of construction

Technical Design Support
•	Interpret building codes, Australian Standards and planning requirements when preparing architectural documentation
•	Assist with material selections, construction detailing and specification preparation to support project outcomes
•	Produce 3D models, presentation drawings and visual representations where required to assist project coordination and client communication

Stakeholder Liaison
•	Liaise with Architects, engineers, project managers, consultants and clients to clarify design requirements and technical information
•	Coordinate drawing revisions and technical documentation arising from project meetings and consultant feedback
•	Support communication between design and construction teams to facilitate efficient project delivery

Quality Assurance and Compliance
•	Review drawings to ensure accuracy, completeness and compliance with project specifications and applicable regulations
•	Maintain drawing standards, templates and documentation procedures in accordance with company quality systems
•	Assist in resolving design documentation issues during construction and support continuous improvement of drafting processes

Assessment Criteria
•	A relevant qualification in Architectural Drafting, Building Design, Architectural Technology, Architectural Interior Design or a closely related discipline, or relevant industry experience
•	At least three years of relevant experience preparing architectural drawings and construction documentation for residential and/or commercial building projects
•	Demonstrated proficiency using computer-aided drafting software such as AutoCAD, Revit or other comparable CAD/BIM platforms
•	Experience preparing and revising floor plans, elevations, sections, construction details and other technical documentation
•	Ability to interpret architectural concepts, engineering drawings and technical specifications and translate them into accurate construction documentation
•	Ability to communicate and coordinate drawings with architects, engineers, consultants and construction personnel throughout project delivery
•	Understanding of construction methods, building materials and document control procedures
•	Experience managing drawing revisions, version control and project documentation
•	Strong attention to detail with the ability to produce accurate and high-quality technical drawings
•	Well-developed communication and organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines
•	Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with all levels of stakeholders


How to apply:

Applications open on 13 July 2026 and close on 12 August 2026 

Please send your CV to info@businessnest.com.au. Please include the job role title in your email.

Full-time Structural Steel Detailer position available with competitive salary. Work in a dynamic team  in Caringbah NSW 2229. 

3 Stand-out Bullet Points:
•	Full-Time Structural Steel Detailer
•	Salary Range: $75,000 - $95,000 per annum plus superannuation
•	Exciting opportunity to work in a professional setting.

About Us
Monte Construction PTY LTD is an Australian structural steel construction company dedicated to delivering high-quality steel fabrication and construction solutions across commercial, industrial, and infrastructure sectors. With a team of experienced engineers, detailers, and fabricators, Monte Construction specialises in the design, detailing, fabrication, and erection of structural steelwork for a diverse range of projects — from multi-storey commercial buildings and industrial facilities to bridges and civil structures. 

About the role
The Structural Steel Detailer transforms architectural and engineering plans into precise 3D models and 2D shop drawings. This role ensures all steelwork is detailed accurately for fabrication and erection. The position requires strict adherence to Australian Standards and project specifications. The successful candidate will bridge the gap between structural design and practical fabrication.

Duties and Responsibilities

•	Generate detailed fabrication drawings, erection plans, and assembly drawings.
•	Produce accurate Bill of Materials (BOM), cutting lists, and bolt lists for procurement.
•	Identify and resolve design clashes before fabrication commences.
•	Draft and submit Requests for Information (RFIs) to engineers or architects to resolve design discrepancies.
•	Liaise with the workshop to resolve fabrication queries and optimize detailing for manufacturing efficiency.
•	Work with site supervisors to ensure erection plans are clear and practical.
•	Ensure all detailing complies with the National Construction Code (NCC) and relevant Australian Standards.
•	Update models and drawings promptly to reflect design changes and site variations.
•	Maintain accurate records of drawing issues, revisions, and transmittals.
•	Self-check all drawings for dimensional accuracy and completeness prior to formal review.

Essential Skills

•	Comprehensive knowledge of AS 4100 (Steel structures), AS/NZS 1554 (Structural steel welding), and AS 5131 (Structural steelwork fabrication and erection).
•	High level of accuracy in drafting and mathematical calculations.
•	Ability to visualize complex 3D structures from 2D architectural and engineering plans.
•	Proven ability to manage multiple project deadlines simultaneously.
•	Clear written and verbal communication skills for technical coordination.
•	Proactive approach to identifying design flaws and proposing practical solutions.

Qualifications needed:

•	Minimum Trade qualification or equivalent relevant work experience
•	Minimum one year of work experience on relevant position

What We Offer

•	Competitive salary based on experience
•	Opportunities for professional growth and training
•	A supportive and dynamic work environment
•	Work on exciting projects with cutting-edge technology

Salary:  The role offers a remuneration package ranging from $75,000-$95,000 plus superannuation for a 38-hour work week.

How to Apply: 11 Recruitment is your pathway to securing this exciting opportunity. We are looking forward to facilitating your application and potentially welcoming you to a company that values expertise. Apply now and let us help you take the next step in your career.
